segments.text: Sounds like hen is in trouble!
How long have you been standing there?
Of course that was just a warm up!
But I'm afraid every bumbum laugh at me!
We came as fast as we could!
The performance is about to begin!
I don't think hen is feeling well.
But they came to hear you saying...
I'm afraid the opera isn't over till the fat lady sings.
It's a wonderful singer when you can't hear her sing.
Now, if you'll excuse me, I have to rest my voice.
